system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes in dressing-gown, lashing furiously with his cane at a bell-pull after striking a match","action":"Holmes springs up from the edge of the bed, match flaring in one hand, cane raised and striking at the bell-pull; Watson half-rising beside him in the dark","setting":"Dim bedroom at Stoke Moran, oak panelling, a high ventilator above the wall, a dark-lantern's single beam cutting through the room","secondaryElements":"Faint gleam of light from the ventilator, a thin drift of smell suggested by hanging haze and a smoking lamp, a wall-mounted bell-pull, a cold stillness beyond the window; the swamp adder is only hinted at by movement near the ventilator","mood":"Tense, gothic, suspenseful, with restrained urgency and gaslit intimacy","timeOfDay":"Deep night, shortly after three in the morning","composition":"Medium shot, Holmes dominant in the foreground lit by the match flare, Watson behind him in shadow, ventilator and bell-pull arranged diagonally to lead the eye upward"}
